## Size=small, Style=standard, State=enabled
**Node ID:** 10446:79914

Standard Icon buttons are low-emphasis buttons. They are used for the lowest priority actions, especially when presenting multiple options. Icon buttons can be placed on a variety of backgrounds. Until the button is interacted with, its container isn’t visible.

## IconButton
**Node ID:** 10446:79757

Icon buttons display actions in a compact layout. Icon buttons can represent opening actions such as opening an overflow menu or search, or represent binary actions that can be toggled on and off, such as favorite or bookmark. Icon buttons can be grouped together or they can stand alone.

**Documentation:**
- [https://m3.material.io/components/icon-buttons/overview](https://m3.material.io/components/icon-buttons/overview)
